components.text: Note: in earlier versions of the mod, Demonite Ore was mined from within procedurally-generated Demon Dungeons. That dungeon system isn't present on this branch, so the ore-mining source described below is not currently accurate here - but the refined materials it fed into (Demonite Fragments and the Hellforged Block, used as capstones on the Tier 5 Blood Altar) are still real, registered items/blocks. Exactly how you currently obtain them is unconfirmed - check JEI or current loot tables in-game.

The Hellforged Block is a sturdy metallic building block, and Demonite Fragments and Hellforged Parts are used in various higher-tier recipes throughout the mod (including upgrading Blood Runes to their augmented form alongside Netherite Scrap).
